# Legacy Industrial Coatings

> Legacy Industrial Coatings is a premier flooring contractor specializing in epoxy flooring, polyurea garage floor coatings, mechanical polished concrete, and specialty industrial coatings. We serve the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex from our Plano, TX headquarters and the greater Phoenix metro from our Scottsdale, AZ office.

## Services

- **Epoxy Garage Floor Coatings** — Premium polyurea flake floor systems for residential garages with a lifetime warranty against peeling, chipping, and UV discoloration. Installed in one day, ready for vehicles in 24–48 hours.
- **Industrial Epoxy Flooring** — High-traffic epoxy systems engineered for warehouses, manufacturing plants, distribution centers, food processing, and aviation hangars.
- **Mechanical Polished Concrete** — Multi-step diamond grinding, lithium silicate densification, and burnishing to deliver dust-free, high-gloss polished concrete floors with FF/FL flatness for commercial, retail, and warehouse facilities.
- **Specialty Waterproofing** — Containment tanks, traffic coatings, and other specialized chemical-resistant systems.
- **Commercial Floor Coatings** — Turn-key DFW commercial flooring solutions including anti-static, FDA-compliant, and chemical-resistant coatings.
- **Residential Patio Coatings** — Decorative flake and concrete overlay systems for patios and outdoor living spaces.

## DFW Service Area

Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Carrollton, Lewisville, Garland, Prosper, Celina, Sherman, Anna, Melissa, Sanger, The Colony, Flower Mound, and the wider North Texas region.

## Common Questions

**Where is Legacy Industrial Coatings located?** Legacy Industrial Coatings is headquartered at 6010 W Spring Creek Parkway, Plano, TX 75024, and serves the entire Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

**How long does a garage floor coating take to install?** Most residential garage floors are completed in a single day and are ready for vehicles within 24–48 hours.

**What is the difference between polyurea and epoxy?** Polyurea is more flexible, cures faster, and resists UV damage better than epoxy, so it lasts longer and is less likely to peel, chip, or yellow. It is Legacy's standard residential garage system.

**Is the work warrantied?** Residential polyurea flake garage floors carry a limited lifetime warranty against peeling, chipping, and UV discoloration. Commercial and industrial systems carry manufacturer-backed warranties matched to each specified system.

**What areas do you serve?** The Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, including Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Prosper, Celina, and the surrounding North Texas region.

**What types of flooring does Legacy install?** Polyurea and polyaspartic flake systems, high-build industrial epoxy, urethane cement, chemical-resistant coatings, mechanical polished concrete, concrete sealing, and specialty waterproofing.

**How can I get a quote?** Call (214) 305-6516 or request a free estimate at https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/contact. Same-day estimates are frequently available.
